stem: A ladder was inspected at shift start, but later a cart strikes one side rail. What is the correct response before reuse?
choices: Continue because the shift-start inspection is still valid
Check only whether the ladder still stands level
Reinspect the ladder for damage before it is used again
Wait until the next shift to document the impact
rationale: Inspection is required before initial shift use and as necessary when events occur that could affect safe condition.
